_comment: A pass needs the overall score at or above `overall` AND each level that the test uses at or above `perLevel`. Tradeoff: a per-level floor stops a strong easy/medium score from hiding a zero on hard coding, so a certificate means the candidate can write code, not only pick answers. The cost is that a candidate who is strong overall but weak in one level fails; raise or lower perLevel here, never in code. Mirrored to the browser by importing this file, so there is one source.
